step_2.name: Particle Density
step_2.plain_english: Number of dust/particle contaminants on the wafer surface

step_3.name: Error Frequency
step_3.plain_english: How often the SCADA control system logs error events per hour

step_4.name: Fault Concentration
step_4.plain_english: Density of detected defects across the solar cell surface

step_5.name: O₂ Concentration
step_5.plain_english: Oxygen level inside the vacuum chamber — too high means contamination

step_6.name: ΔT Temperature
step_6.plain_english: Difference between target and actual furnace temperature

step_7.name: Calibration Error
step_7.plain_english: How far off the pressure sensor reading is from calibrated value

step_8.name: Flow Rate
step_8.plain_english: Precursor gas flow rate as a percentage of the setpoint

step_9.name: Temperature Error
step_9.plain_english: Drift of the deposition source temperature from setpoint

step_10.name: Layer Adhesion
step_10.plain_english: Bond strength of the deposited semiconductor layer to the substrate

step_11.name: Uniformity
step_11.plain_english: How evenly the thin film layer is spread across the panel

step_12.name: PL Intensity Ratio
step_12.plain_english: Photoluminescence uniformity ratio — measures deposition evenness

step_13.name: Peak Intensity
step_13.plain_english: Sharpness of the defect signature peak in spectral analysis

step_14.name: Adjustment Delta
step_14.plain_english: Correction applied to balance oxygen levels — large delta = problem

step_15.name: Deposition Rate
step_15.plain_english: Speed at which the semiconductor material is deposited on the wafer

step_16.name: Defect Recurrence
step_16.plain_english: Number of times the same defect pattern reappears across batches

step_17.name: Avg. Grain Diameter
step_17.plain_english: Average size of crystal grains — larger grains = better conductivity

step_18.name: ΔT Achieved
step_18.plain_english: How well the furnace reached its temperature target (% of setpoint)

step_19.name: Deposition Quality
step_19.plain_english: Overall quality score assigned to the deposited layer after inspection

step_20.name: Grain Size Increase
step_20.plain_english: Growth rate of crystal grains during recrystallization

step_21.name: CdCl₂ Coverage
step_21.plain_english: How completely the CdCl₂ treatment covered the cell surface

step_22.name: New Fault Count
step_22.plain_english: New defects introduced during the activation heat treatment

step_23.name: Density Reduction
step_23.plain_english: How much the defect density dropped after activation treatment
step_23.error_type: Defect density still high after treatment

step_24.name: Residence Time
step_24.plain_english: Time the panel spends inside the grain growth oven

step_25.name: Pinhole Density
step_25.plain_english: Number of tiny holes in the thin film layer per square centimeter

step_26.name: Cooling Rate dT/dt
step_26.plain_english: Speed of cooling after grain growth — too fast causes micro-cracks

step_27.name: Film Stress
step_27.plain_english: Internal mechanical stress in the thin film — too high causes cracks

step_28.name: Line Deviation
step_28.plain_english: How far the laser scribing line drifts from its intended position

step_29.name: Foreign Material
step_29.plain_english: Trace contamination from foreign chemicals or materials

step_30.name: Chamber Pressure
step_30.plain_english: Vacuum pressure inside the deposition chamber

step_31.name: Layer Quality
step_31.plain_english: Final quality score for the back contact metal layer

step_32.name: Pmax Reduction
step_32.plain_english: Drop in maximum output power compared to specification

step_33.name: Cell Efficiency η
step_33.plain_english: Solar cell conversion efficiency — how much sunlight becomes electricity

step_34.name: Reject Rate
step_34.plain_english: Percentage of panels that fail final inspection

step_35.name: Particle Count
step_35.plain_english: Airborne particle count in the cleanroom environment

step_36.name: Pump Efficiency
step_36.plain_english: Vacuum pump performance — degraded pump = poor deposition quality

step_37.name: Data Loss
step_37.plain_english: Percentage of sensor readings that were lost or corrupted

step_39.name: Element Diffusion
step_39.plain_english: Metal atoms diffusing into the semiconductor layer — causes shorts

step_40.name: Oven Temp Stability
step_40.plain_english: Temperature fluctuation inside the activation oven

step_41.name: Current Density Jsc
step_41.plain_english: Short-circuit current density — reflects how well the cell absorbs light

step_42.name: Gas Cost Savings
step_42.plain_english: Calculated gas cost savings — error here means the calculation is wrong

step_43.name: R² Correlation
step_43.plain_english: Statistical correlation of sensor data — low R² means data is noisy

step_44.name: Sensor Temp Error
step_44.plain_english: Calibration drift in the temperature sensor

step_45.name: Skill Retention
step_45.plain_english: Operator competency score — low means training is overdue

step_46.name: Maintenance Overdue
step_46.plain_english: Hours past the scheduled maintenance window

step_47.name: Throughput Rate
step_47.plain_english: Panels produced per hour as a percentage of target rate

step_48.name: False Negative Rate
step_48.plain_english: Defective panels incorrectly passed as good by automated inspection

step_49.name: Fill Factor FF
step_49.plain_english: Fill factor — measures how square the current-voltage curve is (higher = better)

step_50.name: Missing Data Fields
step_50.plain_english: Number of required data fields missing from the batch record
